handoff: Decision: the trade map is 3D (game/map.gd is a Node3D with Camera3D, planets on the XZ plane, world = map units x 0.02); game/galaxy_view.gd is only the 2D galaxy overview Control and is not touched. So no new shader: packs use SphereMesh + StandardMaterial3D in a MultiMeshInstance3D, no fx-programmer request. Each cluster is one MultiMesh (one draw call), per-instance position inside a flattened sphere, rotation and lumpy scale from hash(cluster id) ^ seed_salt, so packs are identical every time. Thinning sets visible_instance_count from main.clusters_in_system(sid)['visible']; surviving rocks stay put. Packs follow cycle end, load and event spawns because they sync in _push_routes_to_map. No collision nodes; map picking is ray maths on planets, so clicks are unaffected.
